name: Amazon RDS
description: Dashboards and alert rules for Amazon RDS, from CloudWatch metrics.
details:
## Setup

1. Stream CloudWatch metrics to Kloudfuse through Kinesis Firehose: [AWS CloudWatch Metrics Integration](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/aws/cloudwatch-metrics/).
2. Include the `AWS/RDS` namespace in the metric stream, or stream all namespaces.
3. OS-level metrics need RDS Enhanced Monitoring: see [CloudWatch Enablement Reference](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/reference/aws/cloudwatch/#rds-enhanced-monitoring).

model.expr:
(avg by (dbinstanceidentifier)(aws_rds_database_connections) - avg_over_time((quantile_over_time(0.84, avg by (dbinstanceidentifier)(aws_rds_database_connections) [1m:]) 
  + 2 * stddev_over_time(avg by (dbinstanceidentifier)(aws_rds_database_connections) [1m:]))[1m:])) > bool 0 or (avg by (dbinstanceidentifier)(aws_rds_database_connections) - avg_over_time((quantile_over_time(0.16, avg by (dbinstanceidentifier)(aws_rds_database_connections) [1m:]) 
  - 2 * stddev_over_time(avg by (dbinstanceidentifier)(aws_rds_database_connections) [1m:]))[1m:])) < bool 0
